test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following devices is used for measuring distance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odometer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A device for **calculating the distance **a car has travelled is an odometer.
 
• The odometer is located on the **dashboard **of the car.
 
• An odometer might be **mechanical or digital.**
 
• The majority of mechanical odometers have many** cogs**. A **numerical digit **is represented by each cog.
 
• Through a driving mechanism and cable, the **cogs rotate** in accordance with the **rotation of the wheels.**
 
• In contrast to mechanical odometers, digital odometers employ a** computer chip to track mileage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gnomon:**

 
 
• It is a gadget designed initially as a time tracking device.
 
• It appears to have been a rod set vertically on a planar surface in its most basic form, then later on a hemisphere's surface.
 
 
 
• **Manometer:**
 
 
• A manometer measures the pressure (static pressure) exerted by a motionless liquid or gas.
 
• It operates on the hydrostatic equilibrium concept.
 
 
 
• **Pyrometer:**
 
 
• ​A pyrometer is a device that detects temperature without having to be in close proximity to the item, i.e. by detecting radiation from the object.
